Name: Shadowmere
Author: Zedxrgal0669
Description:
[b]Gorgeous little horses based off of my favorite steed from Oblivion & Skyrim summoned to Stardew Valley.

[/b][b]Currently Available:
[/b]Oblivion - Saddled
Oblivion - Unsaddled
Skyrim - Saddled
Skyrim - Unsaddled

[b]Planned:
[/b]Nothing right  now

[b]If I feel daring:[/b]
I [i]might [/i]make the other horses of (and maybe dogs) of Skyrim but those will be in a different mod.

[b]Requirements[/b]: Latest version of SMAPI, Content Patcher & Generic Mod Config Menu.

Compatible with the Horse Overhaul & Tractor mods in testing. No issues so far.
Not compatible with other horse skin mods.

[b]Huge thanks to! [/b]The SDV Discord modding community. This is my second mod and they've been a big help in sussing out some hiccups and helping me fix them.

[b]Disclaimer[/b]: Please do not use this mod in part or whole without my permission to create your own mod. I've many days & unknown hours creating the assets and writing the code for this mod. I would really like it to not be taken & used by someone else.
